title: Configuring an Endpoint Credential Scan Notification

blocks.text: You can configure an endpoint credential scan notification to generate emails after endpoints are scanned for exposed credentials and the executive summary report is generated. Emails are sent to the configured users with the executive summary report for further analysis and remediation.
To configure an alert notification for an endpoint credential scan:

blocks.item: Name: Enter the name of the notification.
Alert Type: Select Credential Scanning from the drop-down menu.
Send Notification Every: Select the notification frequency (Daily, Weekly, Monthly, or Quarterly).
Trigger Time: Select a time to trigger the notification.
Users: Select one or more email recipients or users from the drop-down menu.
The endpoint credential scan notification is configured.

blocks.text: After the endpoints are scanned, the users receive an email with the executive summary report. You can leverage this report to identify credential exposure risks, prioritize what issue to focus on first, and mitigate issues before the credentials are compromised.
